传达给那个时代的每一个人。{FB}就像大家，
曾经对我做的一样……{FB}我会吹奏，
我会一直吹奏，{FA}直到生命的尽头。{FB}嘿，{FD:01}……{FB}人类，还有宝可梦……
大家互相帮助，互相关心，{FA}一天天地生活着……{FA}这就是幸福……{FB}去分享这种幸福吧……
请好好地……{FA}活下去！{FD:01}！{FB}你是我——
存在过的证明。{FB} ——致150年后的你
散华
en:
Hey, {FD:01}...
By the time you read this letter,{FA}I will no longer be in this world.{FB}To you,
it may be just a single moment.{FB}But for me...
it's the future, a hundred and fifty years from now.{FB}The Time Flute took me back to the past.{FB}In that distant era,
I met many different people...{FB}I have so much I want to tell you...{FB}But—
there is no chance like that anymore.{FB}Just like the people I met in the past... {FB}one by one they all
turned to dust as time passed.{FB}No matter what it is,
it will end someday...{FB}No matter what life it is,
there is a day it will fade...{FB}Only those who face and understand
that they too will have such a day will know...{FA}what they truly want.{FB}And so I decided—
with the flute's sound, carrying everyone's feelings,{FB}I will convey love and hope
to everyone in that era.{FB}Just as everyone
once did for me...{FB}I will play,
I will keep playing,{FA}until the end of my life.{FB}Hey, {FD:01}...{FB}Humans, and Pokémon...
all helping each other, caring for each other,{FA}living day by day...{FA}That is happiness...{FB}Go and share that happiness...
Please, live...{FA}well! {FD:01}!{FB}You are my
proof of having existed.{FB} —To you, 150 years later
Sange
